def generate_token(username: str) -> str:
    """Generates a valid algebraic token for the given username in XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX format."""
    # Compute seed from username
    seed = 0x5A5A
    for ch in username:
        seed = ((seed << 5) - seed + ord(ch)) & 0xFFFF

    # Derive token components using inverse mathematical invariants
    b1 = seed ^ 0xBEEF
    b2 = 0xCAFE ^ ((b1 * 31 + 0x1337) & 0xFFFF)
    b3 = 0xFEED ^ ((b2 * 17 + 0x7331) & 0xFFFF)
    b4 = (0x1337 - (b1 + b2 + b3)) & 0xFFFF

    return f"{b1:04X}-{b2:04X}-{b3:04X}-{b4:04X}"


def verify_token(username: str, token: str) -> bool:
    """Validates algebraic token format: XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX"""
    parts = token.strip().split("-")
    if len(parts) != 4 or any(len(p) != 4 for p in parts):
        return False
    try:
        b1 = int(parts[0], 16)
        b2 = int(parts[1], 16)
        b3 = int(parts[2], 16)
        b4 = int(parts[3], 16)
    except ValueError:
        return False

    # Seed calculated from username
    seed = 0x5A5A
    for ch in username:
        seed = ((seed << 5) - seed + ord(ch)) & 0xFFFF

    # Check mathematical invariants
    if (b1 ^ seed) != 0xBEEF:
        return False
    if (b2 ^ ((b1 * 31 + 0x1337) & 0xFFFF)) != 0xCAFE:
        return False
    if (b3 ^ ((b2 * 17 + 0x7331) & 0xFFFF)) != 0xFEED:
        return False
    if ((b1 + b2 + b3 + b4) & 0xFFFF) != 0x1337:
        return False
    return True
